channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: A total of 323 vulnerabilities were curated today, with the highest counts in desktop operating systems and network devices, underscoring widespread critical flaws across Microsoft's Windows, Azure, and enterprise infrastructure portfolio. Remote code execution dominates the threat profile, frequently resulting from buffer overflows, use-after-free errors, and insecure deserialization within essential services such as DNS, DHCP, SQL Server, and ASP.NET frameworks. Immediate attention is required for actively exploited shell injection vulnerabilities, authentication bypasses in identity federation tools, and high-severity flaws in cloud storage and virtualization layers that threaten to breach isolation boundaries and enable unauthorized lateral movement.
